steps.title: Click New Post
steps.text: Open **Publish** in the menu and click **New Post** in the top right corner. The green **New** button in the menu does the same from any page.

steps.title: Choose where it goes
steps.text: Tick every channel this post should go to. One post can go to several networks at once.

steps.title: Write your post
steps.text: Type your text. The counter shows how many characters are left for the channels you picked. **AI Assistant** can write a first draft from a short brief, and **Templates** gives you ideas.

steps.title: Add a photo or video
steps.text: Click **Add image or video** and pick a file from your computer. Instagram always needs a photo.

steps.title: Pick the day and time
steps.text: At the bottom, set the date and the time the post should go out. Times are in your own time zone.

steps.title: Press Schedule Post
steps.text: **Schedule Post** puts it in the queue. **Save Draft** keeps it for later without a time. **Send for approval** asks a teammate to check it first.

steps.title: It is now in your queue
steps.text: The post waits in **Queue** and atwebtech publishes it at the time you chose. You can close the page: it goes out without you.

steps.title: Open atwebtech.us and choose Sign up
steps.text: Go to atwebtech.us and click **Start free** or **Sign up**. You only need an email address and a password. No credit card is asked for.

steps.title: Press Sign Up
steps.text: Use a password with at least 8 characters, one uppercase letter and one number or symbol. Then press **Sign Up**.

steps.title: Answer four quick questions, or skip them
steps.text: atwebtech asks what kind of work you do and which networks you care about, so it can suggest the right setup. Pick an answer, or press **Skip**.

steps.title: Press Continue after each answer
steps.text: There are four questions in total. After the last one you land in your new workspace.

steps.title: This is Home
steps.text: Home shows what needs you today, your numbers for the week, and the first steps for a new account. A one-question survey may appear the first time: answer it or close it.

steps.title: The menu on the left takes you everywhere
steps.text: **Publish** is your queue of posts. **Community** is your comment inbox. **Insights** shows your results. **Guide** opens these instructions at any time.

steps.title: Next: connect your first channel
steps.text: Nothing can be published until a social account is connected. Click **Connect Channel** to do that now. The next guide shows how.

steps.title: Open Channels
steps.text: In the menu on the left, find **Channels** at the bottom and click the **+** button, or click **Connect a channel** on Home.

steps.title: Your connected accounts are listed at the top
steps.text: Each connected account shows its network and how many posts a week you plan for it. **Open** changes its posting times. **Disconnect** removes it.

steps.title: Pick the network you want to add
steps.text: Scroll to **Connect a New Channel** and click a network: Instagram, Facebook Page, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky or Mastodon.

steps.title: Sign in on the network's own page
steps.text: atwebtech sends you to that network to sign in and allow access. You never type your social password into atwebtech. Mastodon first asks which server you use.

steps.title: Come back and the channel is ready
steps.text: After you allow access, the network returns you to atwebtech and the account appears in your list. Repeat for each account you want to post to.

steps.title: Set when each channel posts
steps.text: Click **Open** on a channel to choose its posting days and times. New posts added to the queue take the next free time.

steps.title: Queue: everything that is scheduled
steps.text: Posts are listed in the order they will go out. Click a post to change its text, photo or time.

steps.title: Calendar: see your week
steps.text: Switch to **Calendar** for a week view. Click an empty day to write a post for that day.

steps.title: Drafts: posts you have not finished
steps.text: Back in **List**, open **Drafts**. A draft has no time yet. Open one, finish it and schedule it.

steps.title: Failed: fix it and retry
steps.text: If a network refuses a post, it lands in **Failed** with the reason in plain words. Fix what it asks for, then press **Retry**.

steps.title: Approvals: check a teammate's post
steps.text: Posts sent for approval wait in **Approvals**. **Approve** schedules the post. **Request changes** sends it back to Drafts with your note.

steps.title: Sent: what has been published
steps.text: **Sent** keeps every published post with its numbers. **Duplicate** copies a good post into a new draft.

steps.title: Open Insights
steps.text: Click **Insights** in the menu to see how your posts performed.

steps.title: Choose the period
steps.text: Switch between **7 Days**, **30 Days**, **Month to Date** and **Last Month**. Each number shows how it changed against the period before.

steps.title: Read the totals
steps.text: Posts, followers, reactions, comments, shares and views for all your channels together. The small **i** next to a number explains what it counts.

steps.title: Find your best times and hashtags
steps.text: Scroll down for the hours when your posts did best and how each hashtag performed. **Use these times** applies them to a channel's schedule.

steps.title: Learn from your top posts
steps.text: The posts with the most engagement are listed at the bottom. **View** opens the post on its network.

steps.title: Export a report
steps.text: Back at the top, **Export** downloads the numbers as a file you can open in Excel or Google Sheets.

steps.title: Open Automations
steps.text: Click **Automations** in the menu. There are three kinds: blog to social, a weekly AI plan, and automatic replies.

steps.title: Weekly plan: describe your business
steps.text: Open **Set up** on the weekly plan. Tell the AI Assistant what your business is and what customers ask about.

steps.title: Choose channels and how many posts
steps.text: Tick the channels to write for, how many posts a week, and the tone. **Draft** means nothing is published until you have read it.

steps.title: Your automations are listed below
steps.text: Every automation shows what it made so far. **Run now** starts it immediately, **Pause** stops it, **Delete** removes it.

steps.title: Blog to social and automatic replies
steps.text: The first box turns new articles from your blog into posts. The third answers common questions, like prices, with a reply you write once.

steps.title: Open Account
steps.text: Click your name at the bottom of the menu, then **Account**. Here you change your name, password and email alerts.

steps.title: Change your name
steps.text: Type the name teammates should see and press **Save**.

steps.title: Change your password
steps.text: Enter your current password and a new one. Changing it signs you out on every other device, including the phone app.

steps.title: Choose which emails you get
steps.text: Tick what you want to hear about: a failed post, a channel that needs reconnecting, approvals, an empty queue, and a Monday summary.

steps.title: Turn on two-factor authentication
steps.text: For extra safety, **Set up authenticator** asks for a code from an app such as Google Authenticator every time you log in.

steps.title: Delete your account
steps.text: At the very bottom, **Delete my account** removes your account and everything in it for good. It asks for your password and the word DELETE first.

steps.title: Open Community
steps.text: Click **Community** in the menu. Comments from your connected accounts arrive here every 30 minutes. **Refresh** checks right now.

steps.title: Unanswered comments come first
steps.text: Each comment shows who wrote it, on which network and under which post. The tabs sort them into **Unanswered**, **Answered** and **Done**.

steps.title: Write a reply, or let AI suggest one
steps.text: Type your answer in the box. **Suggest a reply** writes a draft for you to edit.

steps.title: Use a saved reply for common questions
steps.text: Pick a saved reply from the list to fill the box in one click. Add your own under **Saved replies** at the top.

steps.title: Press Send reply
steps.text: The reply is posted on the network under your name, and the comment moves to **Answered**.

steps.title: Mark done when no answer is needed
steps.text: **Mark done** clears a comment from Unanswered without replying, for example a simple thank-you.
